landing.faq_desc: Quick answers about BitPaw Software Ecosystem and Marketing Services.
landing.faq_q1: Can BitPaw Smart POS connect to bill printers and barcode scanners?
landing.faq_a1: Absolutely. The BitPaw Smart POS ecosystem is designed with Open API standards. We easily connect with hardware peripherals such as bill printers (Bluetooth/LAN), cash drawers, barcode scanners and especially the Kitchen Display System (KDS).
landing.faq_q2: Do Landing Page design and Marketing services guarantee revenue?
landing.faq_a2: Yes. When businesses use BitPaw's Media Agency services, we don't just design UI/UX, SEO optimized Landing Pages, but also handle Ads Performance. KPIs are clearly agreed based on Conversion Rate (CR) and Cost Per Lead (CPL).
landing.faq_q3: Is HRM data and customer data kept secure?
landing.faq_a3: Data is stored on MongoDB Atlas (encrypted at rest), accessed over HTTPS and by owner/manager/staff roles. Each business only sees its own data, and you can export it at any time.

landing.privacy_content:
This Privacy Policy explains how BitPaw Technology LLC ("BitPaw", "we") collects, uses and protects data in the BitPaw Software web app and the BitPaw Software mobile apps for Android and iOS. The mobile apps only access the camera and location when a staff member clocks in or out (and the camera/photos when you choose an image to upload); this access always requires your permission on the device. Contact: bitpawsoftware@gmail.com.

1. Data We Collect

  • Business owner account data: email, password (hashed, never stored in plain text), business name, industry.
  • Staff data: full name, employee code, phone number, attendance timestamps, and (if GPS check-in is enabled) location coordinates at check-in and check-in verification photos.
  • Your customers' data (submitted by you or by your customers via public booking/ordering/chat channels): name, phone, email, order history, customer-care chat messages.
  • Transaction data: orders, invoices, payment transaction references (we do NOT store credit card numbers — card payments are processed by Square/Stripe; bank transfers use QR codes you configure yourself).
  • Uploaded files: brand logo, cover images, work/attendance proof photos.

2. How We Use Data

Data is collected solely to operate the Service: processing transactions, calculating pay/commission, customer relationship management, sending order/appointment-related notifications, and improving the Service. We do not sell personal data to third parties for advertising purposes.

3. Storage and Security

Data is stored on MongoDB Atlas cloud infrastructure, encrypted in transit (HTTPS/TLS). Passwords are hashed using industry-standard algorithms and cannot be reversed. Access is scoped per business account (each account can only access its own business data).

4. Sharing With Third Parties

We only share the minimum data necessary with partners required to operate the Service, including: international card payment gateways (Square, Stripe) for US-market accounts, and an AI assistant provider (DeepSeek AI) to power chat/content-suggestion features.

5. Your Rights

You may access, correct, or request deletion of your personal data. For account/business data deletion requests, please contact bitpawsoftware@gmail.com, or delete your account yourself in the app at Delete Account.

6. Cookies and Sessions

We use essential session cookies to keep you logged in. We do not use third-party advertising tracking cookies.

7. Children's Privacy

The Service is a business management tool and is not directed at, nor does it knowingly collect data from, children under 13.

8. Changes to This Policy

This policy may be updated from time to time. Last updated: October 2, 2026.

9. Contact

For privacy questions, please contact: bitpawsoftware@gmail.com.
landing.payment_content:
1. Supported Payment Methods

  • Bank transfer via QR code (VietQR): for domestic orders/subscriptions. Customers scan the displayed QR code, transfer funds, and staff/the system confirm receipt manually.
  • International credit/debit cards (via Square/Stripe): for US-market business accounts. Card details are processed directly by Square/Stripe — BitPaw Software does not store card numbers.
  • Cash at point of sale: for in-person transactions.

2. Payment Confirmation Process

For bank transfers, orders remain "Pending" until staff confirm receipt of funds in the system. For card payments, confirmation is automatic based on the response from Square/Stripe.

3. Invoices and Receipts

Upon successful payment, the system generates an electronic receipt that can be printed or emailed. Please retain your receipt for reference.

4. Refund / Cancellation Policy

[Business owner: please add your specific refund/cancellation policy here — e.g. eligibility conditions, request window, cancellation fees if any.] For SaaS subscription plans purchased via the Checkout page, refund terms (if any) will be stated at the time of signup.

5. Transaction Security

All transactions are transmitted over encrypted HTTPS/TLS connections. Card payments follow the security standards of our processing partners (Square and Stripe are both PCI-DSS compliant).

6. Payment Support

If you experience a payment issue, please contact: bitpawsoftware@gmail.com · +84 794 678 904.
